episodes.title: American Poison
episodes.summary: A group of young American heiresses are changed forever when they're whisked across the Atlantic to London.

episodes.title: Women or Wives
episodes.summary: Conchita hosts a raucous country house party. Jinny and Lizzy go head-to-head for the same man. Nan reveals a secret.

episodes.title: The Perfect Duchess
episodes.summary: At the exclusive Tintagel ball, Nan considers the prospect of becoming a duchess. Conchita struggles with her mother-in-law's approval.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: The girls return to New York for a grand celebration. Nan seeks answers from her family. James begins to manipulate Jinny.

episodes.title: Failed Betrayal
episodes.summary: Things unravel during a weekend at Guy's family home, as Nan finds herself feeling torn. Mabel and Honoria get closer.

episodes.title: It's Christmas
episodes.summary: The gang head to Scotland for a Christmas getaway. Lizzy makes a confession. James' behavior escalates. Nan faces a hard choice.

episodes.title: First Footing
episodes.summary: The Brightlingseas host a New Year's Eve party where the bombshell news is the hot topic. Tensions flare as Theo and Guy's rivalry explodes.

episodes.title: Wedding of the Season
episodes.summary: Season finale. Nan must figure out her path forward. Jinny feels trapped. Mrs. St. George reckons with the state of her family.

episodes.title: The Duchess of Tintagel
episodes.summary: Nan's wedding day is in full swing, but a surprise appearance by someone from her past threatens to derail the festivities.

episodes.title: Holy Grail
episodes.summary: Amid the Tintagel spring gala, Lizzy grapples with whether to share crucial information with Nan.

episodes.title: Get Her Out
episodes.summary: A betrayal, a reunion, and an unexpected spark — Lizzy's enchanted birthday party will be one to remember.

episodes.title: Ice Cream
episodes.summary: From sun-drenched Italy to a champagne-soaked English garden party, emotions run high and chances are taken.

episodes.title: A Whole Love
episodes.summary: The Buccaneers prepare for Lizzy's wedding day. Nan returns to face the music as things get more complicated.

episodes.title: Every Single Piece of My Heart
episodes.summary: Tensions are set aside — for now — to help Jinny fight for her freedom.

episodes.title: All Rise
episodes.summary: In New York, the scandalous St. George divorce trial is underway. Nan copes with further revelations about her birth mother.

episodes.title: She Knows
episodes.summary: The end-of-season Tintagel Ball sets off an explosive chain of revelations and betrayals — and Nan's life will never be the same.
